description.value: Craffles is a locally owned brunch restaurant nestled in Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood, serving gourmet crepes, waffles, French toast, eggs benedict, omelettes, and milkshakes all day long. It operates as a full-service, first-come-first-served spot with both indoor and outdoor seating in a warm, welcoming space. The brand has franchise ambitions and positions itself as a daily neighbourhood staple for breakfast through afternoon.
